purpose: Determine which frozen Antarctic Pygoscelis breeding sites have enough repeated optical imagery to estimate long-term change in accessible ice-free breeding opportunity before any demographic magnitude or concentration outcome is joined.

seed_population.source: Collapsed from the previously frozen 107 MAPPPD bridged site x species units using only site identity, geography, record years, method metadata, and the already-built static ice-free atlas.

stac.rationale: Use Landsat at both temporal endpoints to avoid defining habitat change from a cross-sensor early-versus-late contrast. Sentinel-2 is reserved for recent-epoch classification validation.

support_metrics: number of STAC items intersecting the site point
number of distinct austral-summer acquisition dates
number of distinct austral-summer calendar years
summer acquisition-date counts below eo:cloud_cover thresholds of 20%, 40%, and 60% when metadata are present
whether the catalog query reached the configured max-item ceiling

scene_support_gate.rule: All three windows must satisfy the date/year support thresholds and no query may be truncated.
scene_support_gate.interpretation: This is only a catalog-availability gate. It does not establish usable snow-free, cloud-free, shadow-free pixels around the colony.

planned_checks: QA_PIXEL / sensor-native quality flags within a frozen local buffer
valid-pixel fraction after cloud, shadow, and saturation masking
minimum number of independent usable acquisition dates in each Landsat epoch
Sentinel-2 agreement for the recent Landsat classification
prohibited_adaptive_actions: widening the early or late windows in response to demographic outcomes
changing support thresholds after population trends are inspected
dropping sites because their demographic response is inconvenient

stop_rule: If too few sites pass catalog and pixel-quality support, close the longitudinal land-opportunity Paper 2 route without lowering thresholds after outcomes are viewed; retain Paper 3 dynamic-substrate route as the next program branch.
